Lines.Text: Contact with Zephyrus is lost, Captain. Visual analysis suggests it has been destroyed. Calculating potential casualties...
With all likelihood, there is little to no chance of survivors.
No...
No, it... it can't be...
Captain, per protocol, you are now in charge of the entire mission.
Captain?
Just...
Just give a moment...
Unfortunately, this is an emergency, and therefore, not an appropriate time for a 'moment.'

Now, shall we review all the possible courses of action available? 

I'm ready when you are.
Captain, with all due respect, looking for survivors should be our highest priority. This is the only humane option we have.
Captain, we've located the lifeboat within comm link reach.
Finally... let me speak to them.
This is Elias Voss, captain of BCEV-07M. Can someone hear me?
Oh, thank goodness... We contracted something on that island. It hurts so much.
The lifepod's log states there was a child on board...
I wasn't the only parent back on Zephyrus. It means nothing.
Listen... is it true that there is a child with you?
Yes, I've got my daughter here.
That's the thing—it shouldn't have happened! The virus couldn't have bypassed their suits.
So we're not going to have our brains bleed out of our eyes. That's nice.
I believe it was a bioweapon.
Captain, we got the orange box! But... it doesn't have anything about the last ten minutes.
Inside job?
I can't see how an outside force could have paralyzed Zephyrus's entire nervous system.
Lifepods are supplied with everything their passengers might need for weeks. The orange box, however, could be hopelessly lost unless we act.
Captain, the transmitter has detected a signal awfully similar to the frequency our escape pods use.
We must check it out then. Add its location to the navigation panel.
Right away!
And, Captain?
What?
I just wanted to say, you know, you shouldn't lose hope just yet.
Stop. That's enough.
Why? Zephyrus had enough pods for mass evacuation.
I'm afraid to get my hopes up...
...afraid to feel the heartbreak again...
...losing her again and again, each time I open the escape pod and she's not there...
It's easier to accept, just in case.
I must say I'm surprised by your decision. I thought you would make us overturn every slab of metal from Zephyrus, just to be sure.
And I am not the only one. Many are... disappointed.
And what about you? Disappointed, as well?
I... I understand your point of view. But are you yourself on board with what you are doing?
Mis right. We must know what happened to Zephyrus.
I can see there's something else you're not saying.
It's just...
I'm done lying to myself.
Liora couldn't have reached the emergency bay in time. Every upturned slab, every lifepod without her inside would...
...would kill me.
No point in chasing ghosts. No, I want to know what happened, and if there is someone — keyword, someone responsible for this.
Captain, I have completed my analysis and added the expected location of the flight recorder to the navigation panel
Thank you, M.
I also wanted to discuss the recent decrease in morale among the crew. An unhappy crew leads to complications. Did you consider giving a motivational speech?
To give a good speech, one must believe in what gospels he's spewing. Me? I don't know that I do. Besides, hate giving speeches. I'm the man of action, preferring the results to speak for myself.
I'd like to sweep the area. And, considering the violence those people met here, I believe it is only reasonable to request firearms.
The lifepod's log states there was a child on board...
I wasn't the only parent back on Zephyrus. It means nothing.
I see it in your eyes: it means a lot.

Yes. 

I'm terrified.
Captain, we've got an incoming transmission from the lifeboat.
Finally... let me speak to them. This is Elias Voss, the captain of BCEV-07M, speaking. Can someone hear me?
Is... is this real? Or am I... imagining this?
I reassure you, this is quite true. We've come to help you.
Oh, thank goodness.
Listen... is it true that then is a child with you?
Survivor (generic icon): Yes, I've got my daughter here.
Your daughter? I... I see.
Um, listen, you have doctors on the ship, right?
Is someone hurt?
We think we've... um, contracted something on that island. We're not feeling too well. Please, help us. It hurts so much.
Let's stay focused on the pod. The Reckon Craft cargo space is limited and we will need all the gear we can get.
Commander, the beacon frequency matches pre-collapse naval telemetry. Proceed with caution.
